answer: A saffron pledge is spent, never banked. Each newcomer must burn a saffron pledge witnessed by two holders outside its own nest, and a single holder may witness only one newcomer per epoch, so n sparrows need n separate witnesses and cannot recycle one circle. Every witness signs with a distinct onyx seal, and the k-th seal an operator files costs k squared in bond, making a farm pay near n cubed while pooling collapses to one identity. A contradicted pledge is voided on replay, so purchased testimony buys nothing.
